scope: Uncommitted current working-tree source; earlier independent dirty work preserved. Not a release or selected-index qualification.
architecture: Explicit deterministic Python progression -> legacy BCL/1 -> existing guarded skills -> authenticated native Minecraft. Read-only coarse look and targeted search are separate; no LLM, MCP planner, Java or transport changes.
contract_coverage: Fixed progression including mixed-species wood, wooden pickaxe, at least one supported descent, nine distinct stone targets, plank jump placement, surface return and three stone tools.
Independent simulated native shovel/sword recipes validate exact material consumption/result/output and reject receipts-only crafting.
Simulated one- and three-step returns; recorded stair support exclusion; material reserve before descent.
Missing wood/crafting/mining/placement outcomes, unproven mining, wrong equipped tool, missing final tools and false surface return cannot pass.
Actor/player/navigation fences, health, cancellation, deadline-before-observation, bounds, pre-dispatch durable intent, cleanup uncertainty and fresh-ledger/no-resume guards.
Real BCLRunner observation/actor binding integration; other strategy fixtures simulate BCL outcomes and do not replace native motor qualification.
operation_policy: Every failed frame stops; no reconnect, action replay, automatic ascent rescue, respawn, partial-grid repair or stopped-run resumption. Existing native release/leases/F8/TLS unchanged.

world_start.creation: Operator creates/selects a fresh isolated Survival world before invocation; the program does not create or select a world.
world_start.native_preconditions: Matching player/actor/dimension, live, empty inventory/cursor, no initial screen/container, grounded supported navigation.
world_start.attestations: Fresh world, Survival mode, no bonus chest/gifts/other players; current scene API does not independently certify these. World ID is a label.

acceptance.script: Fresh client-observed material/output gains, matching exact-target mining evidence, consumed ascent blocks, grounded surface waypoint and all final tools.
acceptance.safety: Best effort; a stopped player may remain underground.

historical_evidence: Unchanged; no previous failed world or stopped scope was resumed or reclassified.
